meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 把 Telegram 适配器、配对与 markdown 清理辅助文件及测试从 channels 分支复制进项目,注册通道并安装指定版本的适配器包,然后引导你创建 bot、存入 token、重启服务,最后用 4 位配对码完成绑定。
howto.when: 当你要求为项目添加 Telegram 通道时触发,常见于 /setup 流程中,或之后用 /init-first-agent 等命令接线时。

say.text: 帮我给这个项目加上 Telegram 通道
say.note: 会复制适配器文件、注册通道并安装依赖包

say.text: 运行 pair-telegram 步骤,把私聊绑定到当前 agent
say.note: 会打印 4 位配对码,等你发给 bot

say.text: 我的 Telegram bot 收不到群里的消息
say.note: 会提示关闭 Group Privacy 并重新添加 bot

howto.what_en: Copies the Telegram adapter, helpers and tests from the channels branch, registers the channel, installs the adapter package, then guides bot creation, token storage, a restart and 4-digit code pairing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Telegram channel to the project, typically during /setup or when wiring it afterwards with /init-first-agent.

say_en.text: Add the Telegram channel to this project
say_en.note: copies adapter files, registers, installs the package

say_en.text: Run the pair-telegram step to bind my DM
say_en.note: prints a 4-digit code to send to the bot

say_en.text: My Telegram bot ignores group messages
say_en.note: turn off Group Privacy, re-add the bot
